query:
UPDATE transactions
        SET asset_id = $3,
            amount = $4,
            booking_date = $5,
            value_date = $6,
            category_id = $7,
            merchant_id = $8,
            account_amount = $9,
            fx_rate = $10,
            fx_rate_date = $11,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
        RETURNING id
